structured.reason: The mutant narrows the preferred keys to the lowest-numbered free key. When both automatic credentials are free, every request goes to that same key until its limit blocks it. This breaks the requirement that credentials rotate before reuse requires waiting. Existing tests likely allow one request per key per window, which forces the switch and hides the change.
sources: Available credentials shall rotate before reuse requires waiting.
With two available automatic credentials, consecutive requests rotate across them before reuse requires waiting.
structured.test_focus: Set up two auto keys whose limit allows several requests per window. Check that two requests in a row use different key_ids even though the first key is still free.
